description: This PHP source file defines a class 'SchedulersViewDetail' which extends 'ViewDetail'. It is used for handling the display of detailed information about scheduled jobs in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. The class includes methods for generating the module title link and displaying the schedule details, such as interval and user information.

classes.name: SchedulersViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for displaying detailed information of a scheduled job in SuiteCRM. It extends the base 'ViewDetail' class, adding specific logic to display job interval and user info.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleListParam
methods.description: Generates a hyperlink for the module title, pointing back to the Schedulers index. Uses global language string.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and assigns job details like interval and user info to the view, then calls parent display method to render.
